competences.description: Attacks the enemy to disturb its HP recovery for 2 turns with a 70% chance. The damage increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to remove 1 beneficial effect and Silence for 2 turns with a 75% chance respectively. The damage increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)

competences.description: Inflicts Continuous Damage on the enemy for 3 turns when attacking. Inflicts additional damage that's 7% of your MAX HP when you attack on your turn. In addition, increases your Attack Bar by 10% whenever the enemy is inflicted with Continuous Damage on the enemy's turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
